objective: Measure whether open beat/downbeat trackers silently mis-phase bar labels after a single odd-length bar, and whether any confidence signal flags it.
current_unknown: Whether 4/4 bias in published trackers causes long, silent downbeat-phase errors on DJ-style material.
hypothesis: Current tools silently mis-phase after one odd bar: phase error >= 1 beat for >= 4 bars with no confidence dip.
competing_hypotheses: Trackers re-anchor within 1-2 bars after an odd bar (no long error).
Trackers mis-phase but their confidence/activation reliably flags the error.
Errors are tempo-octave errors rather than phase errors.

stages.output: Pass 02 literature review identified DBN meter priors and global-meter task framing.
control_44 fixtures: all systems downbeat F 0.97-0.99, zero missed-downbeat runs.
Pre-registered decision rule in Pass 02 section E; amended to a direction-neutral metric after the smoke run, before the full run.

stages.success_condition: Deterministic render, matched-filter kicks at every truth beat within 12 ms, no spurious kicks, no clipping.
stages.output: 24/24 FIXTURE_ACCEPTED after 3 detector redesigns (no threshold loosened).
tools/grid-meter: fixtures, gate, tracker adapters, scorer, runner, summariser, self-tests.
Gate rejects inserted-kick audio and 30 ms-moved truth beat.

stages.note: First run; results.json becomes the baseline.

stages.output: Finding: offline DBN mislabels 15-16 consecutive bars by 2 beats after one odd bar at every tested tempo with beat F ~0.997; RNN activation separates correct vs wrong downbeats (AUC 0.89-1.00) but DBN output discards it.

attacks.relevance: A fixture whose audio no longer matches its truth must never be scored.
attacks.detail: Extra kick inserted mid-beat -> FIXTURE_REJECTED (determinism + spurious-kick checks fail).

attacks.relevance: A truth file with a mislabelled beat must be caught by the signal check, not trusted.
attacks.detail: One truth beat moved by 30 ms -> FIXTURE_REJECTED.

attacks.relevance: Odd-length bars are timing boundaries the trackers' priors exclude.
attacks.detail: madmom DBN: 15-16 bar mis-phase on ce1/ce2 at all tempos; all systems fail on repeating odd bars.

limitations: Synthetic, clean, EDM-styled fixtures; real tracks have weaker downbeat cues.
Single pre-trained checkpoint per system; no fine-tuning.
Activations are not calibrated probabilities; AUC measures ranking only.
Half-time switch (CE-3) and polymeter (CE-4) fixtures not built.

next_recommended_experiment.reason: The error is detectable in principle (activation AUC 0.89-1.00); test a per-bar disagreement detector so craft automation can fail closed.

human_interventions: None required for this synthetic measurement. Real-track validation needs human-confirmed bar-level annotations (Pass 02 section C.2).
